acquisition_method.evidence: Data were acquired in DDA and DIA modes.
Data were acquired in DDA and DIA modes.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: For protein alkylation, 100 µl of urea buffer and 20 µl of 300 mM iodoacetamide were applied and mixed for 1 min at 20 °C, 600 rpm.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: For protein alkylation, 100 µl of urea buffer and 20 µl of 300 mM iodoacetamide were applied and mixed for 1 min at 20 °C, 600 rpm.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with 3 µl of 1 µg/µl trypsin in 100 µl of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and incubated overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: MS2 was set to perform 15 fragmentation scans, m/z isolation window was set as 2, HCD collision energy 30% with max. injection time of 40 ms and Orbitrap resolution of 15,000.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Precursor ion selection for higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) and MS2 scan was based on the precursor charge state set between + 2 and + 6, intensity threshold higher than 5.0e3.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were ionized with Nanospray Flex Ion Source and analyzed by mass spectrometer operating in a high voltage (2500 V) resolution positive ion mode, ion transfer tube temp. set to 250 °C.

mass_analyzer.evidence: In the full-scan settings, DIA was set as the acquisition method and Orbitrap as the mass analyzer with resolving power 30,000 at 200 m/z.

ptm.evidence: Fixed modifications comprised carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues and variable modifications included methionine oxidization and N-terminal acetylation.

reduction_concentration.evidence: Protein reduction was performed using 100 µl of urea buffer and 20 µl of 100 mM Tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride.
